data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: Configurable defaults for max dispatch and wall-clock budget
- DD7: Happy-path E2E verified in-session

## Description
Document the three new merge config keys in `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` and run an in-session happy-path verification of `merge-to-main.sh --strategy=pr` (or document the verification command/output if a real PR cannot be created).

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` (MODIFY)

## Documentation Required

Add a `merge.*` subsection (or extend existing) covering:

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `merge.pr_max_thread_dispatches` | 10 | Maximum sub-agent dispatches per PR before escalating thread resolution to user |
| `merge.pr_thread_resolution_max_wait_seconds` | 1800 | Wall-clock budget (seconds) for the thread-resolution phase before escalating |
| `merge.pr_thread_quiet_window_seconds` | 120 | Settling heuristic — minimum quiet window before declaring threads done |

Each key entry must include the rationale (why this default), the signal emitted on cap-exceeded (`ESCALATE:thread_resolution`), and the relationship to the existing `merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds` and `merge.pr_max_wait_seconds`.

## Happy-Path E2E Verification

Add a verification record (a comment on this story or a new file `plugins/dso/docs/operations/pr-merge-mode-e2e-record.md`) capturing:
- Date/time of verification
- Branch name and PR number
- Commands run (`merge-to-main.sh --strategy=pr` or equivalent)
- Output excerpts proving: PR created, CI passed, threads resolved (if any), branch merged, exit 0
- `git log origin/main` excerpt showing the merge commit

If a real PR cannot be created in-session (e.g., lack of GitHub remote write access), document the explicit blocker and emit a STATUS:blocked signal — DO NOT mark this AC complete with a synthetic record.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All three config keys documented with defaults and rationale
  Verify: for k in pr_max_thread_dispatches pr_thread_resolution_max_wait_seconds pr_thread_quiet_window_seconds; do grep -qF "merge.${k}" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Happy-path E2E record captured (file or ticket comment) with PR url and merge commit SHA
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/operations/pr-merge-mode-e2e-record.md || .claude/scripts/dso ticket show ccea-922a-8aee-4cc3 | grep -qE 'E2E.*verification|happy-path.*verified'
- [ ] No broken cross-references — all linked sections still resolve
  Verify: grep -oE '\[\[[^]]+\]\]' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | sort -u | while read ref; do echo "ref: $ref"; done

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: T6: Document config keys + happy-path E2E verification
